title: M3E Project Configuration (m3e.json)
description: Declarative Material 3 Expressive project configuration for theme seed, HCT scheme variant, contrast level, physics motion, i18n locale, RTL directionality, CSP, and static CSS emission.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for IDE autocompletion and validation.

style.description: Overall Material 3 visual and physics preset.

seed.description: 6-digit or 8-digit hex seed color used to synthesize the HCT dynamic tonal palette.

schemeVariant.description: Material Color Utilities DynamicScheme algorithm variant.

colorMode.description: Initial color-scheme preference applied to :root for native light-dark() resolution.

contrastLevel.description: HCT contrast level in [-1, 1] (0 = standard, 0.5 = medium contrast, 1 = high contrast).

motionScheme.description: Spring physics motion scheme (expressive allows underdamped spatial bounce; standard is critically damped).

locale.description: BCP 47 locale tag controlling built-in component dictionary lookup and Intl date/time/collation formatting.

direction.description: Document writing direction. When set to 'auto', RTL scripts (ar, he, fa, ur) automatically switch to 'rtl'.

messages.description: Optional project-wide message key overrides merged on top of the active locale dictionary.

nonce.description: Content Security Policy nonce forwarded to Base UI CSPProvider.

disableStyleElements.description: Disables runtime <style> element injection inside Base UI primitives for strict CSP environments.

output.description: Relative output path for static zero-JS-flash HCT light-dark() CSS variables generated by 'm3e sync'.
